description: List check for a mailing list: up to 1,000 different addresses a call, as emails or the text of a CSV (the column headed email). One status each: valid, risky, role, disposable, no_mx or invalid, with a reason, plus counts per status. Format, provider rules and one MX lookup per domain; no email is sent. Daily limit per account; the answer's quota shows what is left today.

csv.description: Or a CSV file's text with an email column.

name: check_list
title: Check a mailing list
